budget_items.topic: FY2017 property tax levy and tax rate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Assessors stated the town is raising a property tax levy of $24,757,321.63, giving a tax rate of $19.97 per $1000 of value, up from $19.61 last year.
budget_items.quote: mr. scheid stated we are looking at raising $24,757,321.63 in property tax revenue. that translates into a tax rate of $19.97 per $1000.00 of value; last year's was $19.61 per thousand.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The original new growth estimate of $300,000 was increased by an additional $187,955 to a total of $487,955.
budget_items.quote: ms. boucher stated the original estimate for new growth was $300,000 but there is an additional $187,955 bringing the total to $487,955.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average single family home value rose from $256,969 to $267,155, and the average tax bill rose 5.8% from $5039.16 to $5335.09.
budget_items.quote: the average tax bill increased by 5.8% from $5039.16 in fy2016 to $5335.09 in fy2017.

budget_items.topic: VHB engineering contract, Summer Street project (Article 1)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Prior-year encumbrance and revised costs for VHB amendments #3 and #4, plus added construction-phase and MBTA fees, leading to a $16,700 adjustment; $187,000 of new growth was cited as available.
budget_items.quote: encumbered $196,500 for amendment #3 of the vhb engineering contract for the summer street project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 3 would raise and appropriate or transfer a sum of money to fund the first year of the FY17-FY19 police contract; the sum was not printed.
budget_items.quote: article 3 will vote to raise and appropriate or transfer from available funds, a sum of money to fund the first

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chapter 44, §63 allows proceeds from sale of a town building for over $500 to go into a special revenue fund.
budget_items.quote: if we sold a town building for over $500 the proceeds from that sale could go into a special revenue fund.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 2 would authorize a sum of money to purchase 200 Reservoir Road (Estate of Vera R. Barney, 20.36 acres); no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: to purchase property located at 200 reservoir road and known as the estate of vera r. barney

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 6 would appropriate $35,000 from the Sale of Cemetery lots account for cemetery care, improvement and embellishment.
budget_items.quote: article 6 votes to appropriate the sum of $35,000 from the sale of cemetery lots account

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY18 salary schedule calculation includes a 2% cost-of-living adjustment approved at the May 2016 Annual Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: which includes the 2% cola approved at the may 2016 annual town meeting

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 9 would appropriate $110,142.36 from PEG access and cable related fund revenues to supplement the FY17 PEG Access Committee budget after a calculation error.
budget_items.quote: the sum of $110,142.36 to supplement the amounts voted under article 25 of the may 7, 2016

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed a payroll warrant, a payroll deductions warrant and an accounts payable warrant.
budget_items.quote: the board signed a payroll warrant in the amount of $765,669; a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $512,508.84 and an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $246,996.93.
